senses.gloss: (b. h.) to scrape; to chisel. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14 below the Israelites were sitting חוֹרְטִין את העגל וכ׳ chiselling the calf …, and above the Lord engraving the tablets.

units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 3:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. III</cite> <he>אם איני מַחֲרִיט … יסודותיו וכ׳</he> unless he models … its foundations and its entrances and exits, he does not begin to build.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 3:5">Ib.</cite> <he>הקב״ה ה׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> the Lord modelled before Him the world, but it would not stand.

senses.gloss: [to scratch one’s self,] to regret, feel sorry.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5a:9">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ומִתְחָרֵט בו</he> and feels sorry for it.
<cite ref="Niddah 31b:36">Nidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְחָרֶטֶת</he> she regrets (her vow of abstinence); a. fr. V. <cite ref="H01662"><he>חֲרָטָה</he></cite>.
